items.title: What 1,250 Professionals Say About Working With AI
items.summary: Anthropic asked 1,250 professionals how AI is actually changing their work, and the results reveal a blend of optimism, anxiety, and shifting identity—creatives feeling squeezed, scientists wanting trustworthy partners, and most workers hoping to hand off routine tasks while keeping what defines their craft. The episode also looks at how AI-run interviews collapse the old scale-vs-context tradeoff in research and what that means for understanding real-world AI impact. Headlines include Gemini 3 Deep Think, Replit’s enterprise push with Google, Opus 4.5’s benchmark surge, Salesforce’s Agent Force momentum, and Meta’s pivot away from the metaverse. // Abstract

Spencer Reagan thinks it might be, and he’s not shy about saying so. In this episode, he and Demetrios Brinkmann get real about the messy, over-engineered state of agent systems, why LLMs still struggle in the wild, and how enterprises keep tripping over their own data chaos. They unpack red-teaming, security headaches, and the uncomfortable truth that most “AI platforms” still don’t scale. If you want a sharp, no-fluff take on where agents are actually headed, this one’s worth a listen.

items.title: The Biggest Cybersecurity Challenges Facing Regulated and Mid-Market Sectors - with Cody Barrow of EclecticIQ

Cody joins Emerj Editorial Director Matthew DeMello to discuss how AI-driven analytics and automation are revolutionizing threat detection and response in enterprise cybersecurity.
